actual_scope: For the pinned Section 08 parameters with epsilon=2^-75, prove an explicit all-size prime-length selector transfer and deterministic sublinear trial-division setup bound, conditional only on the stated Rosser-Schoenfeld Chebyshev estimate.
bottleneck_link: The source assembly needs d distinct prime lengths satisfying its no-sort resampling size, coprimality, product, and gap requirements. This proves that setup implication and its search cost under the imported prime estimate; it does not affect selected kappa or supplier obligations.
stop_rule: Stop after the source-pinned all-size selector proof, exact sufficient cutoff, explicit conditional premise, setup-cost bound, and registered verifier replay; do not infer the full multiplication theorem.
evidence: PROOF.md proves that for every source input with b>=5^(2^75), d=floor(b^(2^-75)) and the pinned T,r,t_i choices, the imported Rosser-Schoenfeld theta estimate yields at least d primes in each required interval. It proves distinct odd selection, T/2<S<T, 1/8>t_i/s_i-1>1/(4d), alpha^4(t_i/s_i-1)>p, and O(d r^(3/2) poly(p))=n^o(1)=o(n) deterministic trial-division setup. verify.py checks source identity, exact rational reductions, and finite geometry controls; it is not a numerical prime search or proof of the imported estimate.
